sn46.41:1.2: “Bhikkhus, whatever ascetics or brahmins in the past abandoned the three discriminations, all did so because they had developed and cultivated the seven factors of enlightenment.
sn46.41:1.3: Whatever ascetics or brahmins in the future will abandon the three discriminations, all will do so because they will have developed and cultivated the seven factors of enlightenment.
sn46.41:1.4: Whatever ascetics or brahmins at present abandon the three discriminations, all do so because they have developed and cultivated the seven factors of enlightenment.
sn46.41:1.6: The enlightenment factor of mindfulness … the enlightenment factor of equanimity.
sn46.41:1.7: Whatever ascetics or brahmins in the past …
sn46.41:1.9: at present abandon the three discriminations, all do so because they have developed and cultivated these seven factors of enlightenment.”
